pages.title: Pages
pages.description: One page per line: a vanity slug ('dominos') or a full Facebook page URL. Both forms reduce to the same page.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Page URLs, for pasting a list straight out of another actor's dataset.

maxReviewsPerPage.title: Max reviews per page
maxReviewsPerPage.description: Facebook streams the reviews tab about three reviews at a time, so 100 reviews costs roughly 34 requests. The rating summary (percent recommend and total review count) is read in the very first request and is returned whatever this is set to.

onlyRecommended.title: Only positive reviews
onlyRecommended.description: Keep only reviews that recommend the page.
onlyRecommended.groupDescription: Applied after fetching, so the run summary still reflects what was read.

onlyNotRecommended.title: Only negative reviews
onlyNotRecommended.description: Keep only reviews that do not recommend the page - the complaints view. Cannot be combined with 'Only positive reviews'.

onlyWithText.title: Only reviews with written text
onlyWithText.description: Drop votes that carry no written review.

textContains.title: Review text contains
textContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the review body.

postedAfter.title: Posted on or after
postedAfter.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Reviews with no timestamp are dropped.

emitSummary.title: Add a run summary record
emitSummary.description: Append one RUN_SUMMARY record: reviews collected, how many recommend, how many do not, and how many carry written text.

exportFormats.title: Extra export files
exportFormats.description: Also write the results to the key-value store in these formats. The dataset is always produced regardless.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Recommended on the Apify platform if you want more than the first few reviews. Facebook serves the rendered first page fine from any IP, but on Apify's datacenter IPs it answers the very first pagination request with "Rate limit exceeded" - measured 2026-09-20. Switching the Apify proxy on with the RESIDENTIAL group restored full pagination in the same test (60 ads over 4 pages against 30). Running from your own machine, no proxy is needed at all. The actor logs a warning naming this when it happens, so a short run is never silently mistaken for a short result set.
